records.name: 三维关系网探索
records.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE additional mobile web UI state for the selected 银河AI知识图册. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE, NOT a layout to copy for every page. Preserve its warm ivory paper grain, elegant ink serif headings, comfortable Chinese text, muted moss/sage/ochre icons, thin warm-gray rules, restrained outlined controls. No heavy green filled panels, glowing sci-fi appearance, desktop layout, hardware frame, OS status bar or browser chrome. Design for a readable 390px-wide phone. This is a functional concept reader, not a landing page. Internal concept IDs are never shown. Text facts below are authoritative; do not invent achievements, course categories, mastery scores, extra explanations or facts.
STATE: FULL 3D RELATIONSHIP EXPLORATION, after entering from the accepted reading-page thumbnail. Make this genuinely spatial: volumetric sage/ochre spheres in perspective at different depths, fine connecting lines, occlusion and restrained shadows, not a flat node circle or poster. A warm-paper fullscreen spatial canvas occupies most of the mobile viewport. Only current node 大语言模型 and a selected neighboring node 模型 need readable labels; other nodes may be unlabeled schematic points. These are visual samples, not an exact rendering of all source data.
Header: back action 返回正文, title 关系网, search icon. Compact 全图 / 邻域 selector with 邻域 active, and 先修 / 相关 filters. Highlight exactly one prerequisite connection 模型 → 大语言模型, arrow toward 大语言模型, never bidirectional; related sample links must have no arrow. A small contextual hint anchored to the selected edge says “模型是大语言模型的先修概念”; no permanent explanation panel.
A compact bottom selection sheet shows 大语言模型, small metadata 认知层级：理解, 41个相邻概念, and a refined outlined 阅读正文 action, plus 相邻概念 list entry. Accessible compact controls 定位 / 暂停 / 怎么看 stay outside this sheet; don't cover the main graph with text or giant controls. Reading returns to its saved position. No giant mountain footer on the exploration canvas; paper grain only. The real 3D graph and dynamic motion will be implemented later, do not pretend this image validates interaction.

STATE: SAME accepted concept reader scrolled down to the extended content area, with several reading sections unfolded. This is not a redesigned first screen or a separate course. Render these actual original paragraphs exactly, as full-width expanded disclosure sections with clear fold affordances:
类比: 像超强的“接话高手”，根据前文猜下一个词；但需指出它没有理解与意图。
常见误解: 误解为“LLM理解语言、知道事实”（其基于统计规律生成，可能产生不实内容）。
反例: 把“说得像真的”当作“知道是真的”。
Below, show collapsed entries 深度、安全、来源 with expand arrows; 案例 remains reachable through the contents. Don't write any new prose for collapsed entries. All original card fields remain accessible by scroll/expand rather than tiny multi-column text.
No large graph card here, because this represents a scrolled reading state; it must be linked back to the approved first screen. Spacious but efficient mobile line lengths. The expanded area should feel like part of the same document, with no heavy colored box or detached pop-up sheet.
